import inspect
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from hypothesis import HealthCheck, given, settings, strategies as st

import lsdb

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
DATA = ROOT / "tests" / "data"
SMALL_SKY = DATA / "small_sky"
COLLECTION = DATA / "small_sky_order1_source_collection"


def _parquet_files(base: Path):
    return sorted(p for p in (base / "dataset").rglob("*.parquet") if p.is_file())


def _filename_param():
    params = inspect.signature(lsdb.catalog.Catalog.write_catalog).parameters
    for name in params:
        if name not in ("catalog_name", "default_columns") and ("file" in name or "name" in name):
            return name
    return None


def test_write_catalog_npix_suffix_slash_creates_npix_directories(tmp_path):
    """Writing with npix_suffix="/" puts each pixel's parquet file inside an Npix=x directory."""
    cat = lsdb.open_catalog(SMALL_SKY)
    out = tmp_path / "out"
    cat.write_catalog(out, as_collection=False, npix_suffix="/", progress_bar=False)
    files = _parquet_files(out)
    assert files
    for f in files:
        assert f.parent.name.startswith("Npix="), f
        assert f.parent.parent.name.startswith("Dir="), f


def test_default_file_name_in_npix_directory(tmp_path):
    """By default the parquet file inside an Npix directory is named 0.parquet."""
    cat = lsdb.open_catalog(SMALL_SKY)
    out = tmp_path / "out"
    cat.write_catalog(out, as_collection=False, npix_suffix="/", progress_bar=False)
    assert all(f.name == "0.parquet" for f in _parquet_files(out))


def test_default_layout_unchanged_without_npix_suffix(tmp_path):
    """Without npix_suffix the catalog is still written as Npix=x.parquet files."""
    cat = lsdb.open_catalog(SMALL_SKY)
    out = tmp_path / "out"
    cat.write_catalog(out, as_collection=False, progress_bar=False)
    files = _parquet_files(out)
    assert files
    assert all(f.name.startswith("Npix=") and f.name.endswith(".parquet") for f in files)


def test_npix_directory_catalog_reads_back_equal(tmp_path):
    """A catalog written with Npix directories reads back with the same rows and pixels."""
    cat = lsdb.open_catalog(SMALL_SKY)
    out = tmp_path / "out"
    cat.write_catalog(out, as_collection=False, npix_suffix="/", progress_bar=False)
    back = lsdb.open_catalog(out)
    assert back.get_healpix_pixels() == cat.get_healpix_pixels()
    assert len(back.compute()) == len(cat.compute())


@settings(max_examples=5, deadline=None, suppress_health_check=[HealthCheck.function_scoped_fixture])
@given(name=st.text(alphabet="abcdefghij0123456789", min_size=1, max_size=8))
def test_custom_file_name_used_for_every_pixel(tmp_path_factory, name):
    """A custom base file name is used for the parquet file of every pixel."""
    param = _filename_param()
    if param is None:
        pytest.skip("no file name argument found")
    cat = lsdb.open_catalog(SMALL_SKY)
    out = tmp_path_factory.mktemp("o") / "out"
    cat.write_catalog(out, as_collection=False, npix_suffix="/", progress_bar=False, **{param: name})
    files = _parquet_files(out)
    assert files
    assert all(f.stem == name for f in files)
    back = lsdb.open_catalog(out)
    assert len(back.compute()) == len(cat.compute())


def test_margin_uses_same_layout_as_main_catalog(tmp_path):
    """The margin catalog is written with the same Npix directory layout as the main catalog."""
    cat = lsdb.open_catalog(COLLECTION)
    out = tmp_path / "out"
    cat.write_catalog(out, as_collection=True, npix_suffix="/", progress_bar=False)
    parquets = [p for p in out.rglob("*.parquet") if "dataset" in p.parts]
    assert parquets
    margin_files = [p for p in parquets if "margin" in str(p.relative_to(out))]
    main_files = [p for p in parquets if p not in margin_files]
    assert margin_files and main_files
    for f in margin_files + main_files:
        assert f.parent.name.startswith("Npix="), f
        assert f.name == "0.parquet", f


def test_overwrite_behavior_kept(tmp_path):
    """Writing over an existing catalog fails without overwrite and succeeds with overwrite=True."""
    cat = lsdb.open_catalog(SMALL_SKY)
    out = tmp_path / "out"
    cat.write_catalog(out, as_collection=False, npix_suffix="/", progress_bar=False)
    with pytest.raises(Exception):
        cat.write_catalog(out, as_collection=False, npix_suffix="/", progress_bar=False)
    cat.write_catalog(out, as_collection=False, npix_suffix="/", progress_bar=False, overwrite=True)
    assert _parquet_files(out)


def test_to_hats_accepts_npix_suffix(tmp_path):
    """to_hats also accepts npix_suffix="/" and writes Npix directories."""
    cat = lsdb.open_catalog(SMALL_SKY)
    out = tmp_path / "out"
    cat.to_hats(out, as_collection=False, npix_suffix="/", progress_bar=False)
    files = _parquet_files(out)
    assert files
    assert all(f.parent.name.startswith("Npix=") for f in files)
